verdict.rationale: Mixpanel documents its own Feature Flags API, published as an OpenAPI spec on its 'Docs for AI Agents' page, so an agent can work with flags programmatically. The only described function, though, is assigning users to variants (evaluation and rollout). Nothing shows creating, targeting or toggling flags, and the hosted MCP server's documented tools cover analytics queries and dashboards, not flags. missing for 10: documented flag create/update/toggle endpoints, targeting-rule management via API, MCP tools for feature flags, hands-on or independent corroboration of agent-driven flag management.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can have an agent create, target, and toggle feature flags through the API or MCP server

citations.quote: Use the Feature Flags API to assign your users to variants for experiments, rollout, and releases.
Every Mixpanel API is described by an OpenAPI specification. Use these to generate client code, validate requests
